derivation: from the same as H1314 (בֶּשֶׂם); fragrant;
def: Mibsam, the name of an Ishmaelite and of an Israelite

occurrences.text: These are their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
